Grandmark International Pretoria is an automotive parts and motor spares supplier on Malie Street in Zandfontein, stocking vehicle body parts, auto air conditioning components, glass and glass accessories, braking systems, clutch and electrical parts, drawing on brands such as Bosch, Mahle, Champion Filters and its own Grandmark Glass range.

The Pretoria branch is part of the wider Grandmark International network, which trades from branches in Bloemfontein, Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, East London, George, Gqeberha, Nelspruit and Polokwane as well as in Namibia, and is a shareholder in the Temot International parts group. The store serves workshops, panel beaters and vehicle owners from its Zandfontein premises, open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00.

Grobbelaars Funeral Services - Riviera is a funeral parlour on Annie Botha Avenue in Riviera, Pretoria, providing a full range of bereavement care that includes cremations, memorials, the construction of a wall of remembrance, and the repatriation of the deceased for families who need a loved one returned from elsewhere in South Africa or abroad. Staff can be reached around the clock, including by SMS, for families who need to arrange a funeral or ask a question outside normal office hours.

Alongside its funeral services, Grobbelaars also operates as a financial services provider offering funeral cover, employee funeral benefits and pre-paid funeral contracts, so cover can be arranged well before it is needed rather than left until a death in the family. The Riviera parlour operates around the clock, open 24 hours a day to assist families whenever a death occurs, in Riviera and the wider Pretoria Moot area.

J&E Cash 'n Carry is a wholesale cash and carry store in Pretoria West that has traded since 1945, stocking a broad range of goods across health and pharmacy, household essentials, personal care and beauty, baby and kids' products, drinks and beverages, cleaning and laundry supplies, groceries and pantry items, hardware and electrical goods, and stationery and office supplies.

The store serves traders and store owners buying in bulk as well as the general public, and offers delivery available around South Africa for customers who cannot collect in person. J&E Cash 'n Carry trades from Pretoria West Monday to Thursday and Friday from 08:00 to 17:00, closing over midday on Fridays for prayers, Saturdays from 08:00 to 12:30, and is closed on Sundays.

Jabezz Art & Crafts is an art and craft studio and academy in Clubview offering more than 20 workshops covering mosaic work, painting, pottery and furniture upcycling, guided by its own artists in a studio that seats up to 25 learners. Beyond standard classes, the studio hosts bridal showers, birthday parties, women's day gatherings and teambuilding sessions built around a shared creative activity, and takes on custom commission pieces for clients who want something made to order.

For those who cannot attend in person, Jabezz also runs online workshops using supplies customers already have or can order through its retail shop, which stocks art and craft kits, décor and tools. The studio trades from Adam Tas Street in Clubview, Centurion, Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays until 14:00.

Jlu Electrical is an electrical contracting business operating from Constantia Park in Pretoria East, carrying out new electrical installations and full rewiring projects for residential and commercial clients. The team also handles ongoing maintenance work and issues certificates of compliance, the documentation confirming that a property's electrical installation meets South African safety standards.

Beyond standard contracting work, Jlu Electrical supplies and installs backup power systems, including UPS units and generators, along with solar power systems for homes and businesses looking to reduce their reliance on the grid. The company also carries out security-related electrical work, including gate motor installation and repair, electric fencing and CCTV systems, for clients around Constantia Park and the wider Pretoria East area.

KCL Protection Services is a security company in Eersterust founded in 2021, providing armed response, alarm monitoring and CCTV surveillance for retail stores, residential estates, shopping centres and government institutions, including security for the Pick n Pay in Eersterust. The company operates 24 hours a day, every day of the year, and is registered with the Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority.

A Level 1 B-BBEE contractor, KCL runs its own control room that keeps constant contact with field teams and conducts regular testing of its alarm and CCTV systems to keep them functioning reliably. The company also prioritises internal promotion and skills development for its staff, and is working towards setting up its own accredited training centre for security personnel.

Keystone Electronic Solutions is an electronics research-and-development company based in Waterkloof, Pretoria, founded in 2007 by two engineering directors, designing bespoke hardware, embedded systems and Internet of Things solutions for South African industry from concept through to production. Its in-house work spans embedded software development, IoT hardware design, and web and mobile application development for clients who outsource their product development rather than building an engineering team of their own.

Among its own product lines is GeoSense, developed through the company's research and development arm, alongside a portfolio of client case studies built up since its founding. Keystone operates from Julius Jeppe Street in Waterkloof, serving businesses across South Africa that need an external engineering partner for electronic product design.

La Pentola is a restaurant in Riviera that has served international fusion cuisine drawing on French, Italian and Mediterranean influences combined with local produce since opening in 1995. Its kitchen built a reputation over three decades for blending these culinary traditions into a single, consistent menu rather than keeping them separate.

The restaurant has two dining areas, making it a popular choice for year-end parties and corporate functions as well as everyday lunches and dinners, with a menu suited to both casual visits and larger group bookings. Operating from Riviera Galleries on Well Street in Riviera, La Pentola serves lunch and dinner Monday to Saturday and is closed on Sundays.

Liquid-IS is a software development company based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, established in 2011 to build custom web and mobile applications as well as its own SaaS products for clients across several industries. Its product range includes a learning management system for training providers, an HR and payroll platform for managing staff administration, and an event ticketing system for organisers running public or private events.

The company has built a client base spanning schools, hospitality businesses and professional services firms, developing software tailored to each sector's workflow rather than a single off-the-shelf product. Liquid-IS operates from Hertzog Street in Wonderboom South, serving clients across Pretoria and beyond.

Locanet Electronics specialises in repairing laptops, PCs, monitors and other IT hardware from its premises in Bronberrik, Centurion, carrying out board-level repairs on laptops, PCs, UPS systems and inverters where a faulty component rather than the whole unit can be replaced. Its technicians also handle software reloads and data recovery for customers whose machines have stopped working or lost their operating system.

Alongside its repair work, Locanet Electronics sells new and refurbished computer equipment, giving customers a lower-cost option when a repair is not worthwhile. The business operates from Unit 4B in the Commercial Complex on South Street, Centurion Central, serving customers across Centurion and the wider Pretoria area.

Marion (Pty) Ltd is a privately owned South African software company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Irene, Centurion, specialising in custom software development, cloud services and business consulting. Over more than three decades the company has built a reputation for developing bespoke systems tailored to a client's own processes, rather than adapting a client's business around an off-the-shelf software package.

Its client base includes major corporates such as Metropolitan, Momentum and Old Mutual, reflecting a focus on large-scale, enterprise-grade software projects for the financial services sector, where systems need to integrate with existing infrastructure and meet strict regulatory and security requirements. Marion operates from Victoria Link in the Route 21 Business Park, Irene Extension 72, serving corporate clients from its Centurion base in Gauteng.

Masthead (Pty) Ltd, established in 2004, offers nationwide compliance and business support to independent financial advisors, corporate financial services providers, credit providers, and legal and property practitioners. Its team helps clients navigate regulations including FAIS, FICA, POPIA and the National Credit Act, providing practical solutions across compliance, practice management and business development so that client businesses can stay compliant and continue to grow.

Masthead (Pty) Ltd forms part of the wider Masthead Group alongside Masthead Financial Planning (Pty) Ltd, a licensed financial services provider that supports financial advisors with operational and regulatory solutions. The company is a Level 1 B-BBEE contributor and holds ISO 27001 certification, and operates from Waterkloof Glen in Pretoria.

Meeting Planners International, established in 2013 and based near Boardwalk Manor, is a Professional Conference Organiser, venue-finding and event management company devoted to coordinating conferences and special events within the SADC region. The company has successfully managed and booked 1,290 conferences and events at 537 unique venues, with a combined attendance of close to 110,000 delegates across 77 long-standing clients.

Its client base spans the public, corporate, academic and association sectors, and its services cover venue sourcing, conference management, event planning, exhibitions, entertainers and speakers, and virtual and hybrid events. Meeting Planners International works with local and international clients from its base near Boardwalk Manor, Faerie Glen, Pretoria.

Mernok Elektronik designs, manufactures and supplies proximity detection systems and vehicle management systems for South Africa's mining industry, helping mine operators track vehicles and equipment and reduce the risk of collisions underground and on surface operations. The company has operated from Rooihuiskraal, Centurion since it was founded in 2008.

In 2023 Mernok Elektronik was acquired by Epiroc, a global mining equipment group, bringing its safety and situational-awareness technology into a larger international product range while the company has continued to operate from its original Centurion base. It remains a specialist supplier to mines across the country that need proximity detection and vehicle management technology.

Metricon Projects has provided construction and project management services to a group of resorts for the past eight years from its base in Shere, Pretoria, focusing on home development, renovations and home improvement projects. The company positions itself around completing work with quality materials and within practical timeframes, rather than taking on open-ended projects that run over budget or schedule.

Metricon's client base centres on resort-style developments, giving it experience managing projects where multiple units or phases need to be coordinated, alongside standalone renovation and home improvement work for individual property owners. This mix of resort and residential project management means the team is used to working within an existing estate's rules and timelines as well as on a single stand-alone home. The company operates from Lombardy Business Park in Shere, serving clients in and around Pretoria.

Minit Print was founded in May 1981, growing from a small city-centre print shop with four staff into a team of 60, three of whom are original employees still with the business today. The company now operates from a custom-built 1,000-square-metre production facility in Hatfield, offering litho and digital printing, binding, folding, thermal laminating, foiling and embossing to individuals, small businesses and large organisations across Pretoria and beyond.

Still guided by its founding family and an experienced management team, Minit Print has grown to include branches in Centurion and Pretoria North, and its staff have received international printing awards for their work. The Hatfield facility on Lynnwood Road, Menlo Park, serves as the company's main production site in Pretoria.

Minuteman Press Rosslyn, established in 2020 at Rosslyn Corner Shopping Centre, offers digital design and print services including business cards, flyers, brochures, banners and signage for businesses across Akasia and the wider Pretoria area. The branch forms part of the international Minuteman Press franchise network, bringing an established design and print process to a local shopfront.

The Rosslyn branch runs a delivery service for customers who cannot collect their orders in person, and has invested in a Xerox Versant 180 press to expand its production capacity for larger print runs. It operates from Piet Rautenbach Street in Rosslyn, Akasia, serving businesses that need design work alongside their printing.

Montagu Trading Company, at Raslouw Lifestyle Centre in Centurion, is a franchise store of Montagu Dried Fruit & Nuts, one of South Africa's foremost dried fruit, nuts and seed importers and suppliers. The brand's range covers sun-dried fruit, wholesome seeds, roasted and salted nuts, flavoured snack blends, traditional biltong and droëwors, and a Great Value everyday snacking range, each carrying the Montagu Goodness quality promise.

As part of a national network of more than 130 stores, the Celtisdal branch gives shoppers access to the full Montagu product range without needing to order online, from gift boxes for special occasions to everyday pantry staples. The store trades from the Raslouw Lifestyle Centre on Hendrik Verwoerd Drive, Raslouw, Centurion.

Montana Repairs & Construction is a household maintenance and construction business in Doornpoort, Pretoria, with more than 20 years of experience specialising in painting, kitchen fittings and ceiling installations as a one-stop renovation solution. The company uses SABS-approved materials and its own trained personnel rather than subcontractors, covering construction, ceiling work, kitchens, painting and waterproofing for residential clients.

Working from planning through to completion, the team focuses on neat, durable results delivered with clear, customer-focused communication throughout a project. Montana Repairs & Construction operates from Apache Avenue in Doornpoort, serving homeowners across Pretoria who need renovation work handled by a single contractor.

MSP Consultants is a business consulting firm in Moregloed offering workplace safety and compliance services, including safety file and contractor pack administration, risk assessments, audits and inspections, and medical screenings for workers in regulated industries. Alongside its safety work, the firm also provides recruitment, labour relations, onboarding and HR policy support to client businesses that would otherwise need to run these functions separately.

This combination of safety compliance and human resources services lets MSP Consultants support a client through the full employment lifecycle, from recruiting and onboarding new staff to keeping their workplace compliant with occupational health and safety requirements and managing labour relations issues as they arise. The firm operates from Sable Avenue in Moregloed, Pretoria, serving businesses across the city that need both HR and safety compliance support from a single provider.

Muckleneuk Manor is a boutique four-star guesthouse in the leafy suburb of Muckleneuk, Pretoria, with seven double rooms set around a garden and an outdoor swimming pool. Each room includes free WiFi, a workstation, bathroom, DSTV, and tea and coffee facilities, and the property also offers spa treatments and a 24-hour front desk for guests arriving at any hour.

Privately owned, Muckleneuk Manor has been ranked among Pretoria's top bed & breakfasts on TripAdvisor, and also hosts intimate events such as baby showers, bridal showers and birthdays. The guesthouse operates from Mears Street in Muckleneuk, serving business travellers and tourists looking for affordable, individualised accommodation close to the city centre.

Multiloads (Edms) BPK is a transport company based in Rosslyn, Akasia, established in 1988 and still run by its founding members, moving packaged consumer goods and industrial products across Southern Africa. Its fleet of 103 truck tractors and rigid vehicles includes Superlink tautliners, flat decks, tri-axle flat decks and low-bed trailers, supported by its own workshop facilities for maintenance.

The company is involved in social upliftment through joint ventures with black-owned small businesses, outsourcing some functions to BEE subcontractors and providing them with technical and financial assistance. Multiloads also runs a dedicated driver training programme with a full-time training officer, and is working towards SETA accreditation for its training facility, operating from Van Niekerk Street in Rosslyn, Akasia.

Multotec Wear Linings operates a Pretoria North factory, established in 1982, manufacturing customised ceramic wear-lining solutions for bulk material handling industries including coal-fired power stations, mining and mineral beneficiation plants, petrochemical plants, iron ore and metal processing facilities, paper-making companies and cement plants. Its product range covers standard, engineered and specialised ceramics, ceramic pipe tiles, medium density tiles, MultoCano chutes, pulley lagging equipment, impellers, quick-fit clamps and panels, multoslip sheets and epoxy adhesives.

The branch also provides a site installation service, fitting its wear-resistant products directly onto client equipment rather than supplying parts alone, and invested in CNC shaping technology in 2019 to produce engineered wear sets on-site. Multotec Wear Linings operates from Bolter Avenue, Pretoria North, serving industrial and mineral-processing clients across the region.

N Mehlomakulu Attorneys is a South African law firm specialising in property, labour and administrative law, with particular expertise in land claims, land tenure, land redistribution and evictions. The firm also handles disputes involving Communal Property Associations and trusts, and runs training in land and property law alongside its litigation and dispute resolution work.

Its practice combines legal advice and consultation, court representation and alternative dispute resolution, aiming to empower individuals and communities navigating South Africa's land reform landscape. N Mehlomakulu Attorneys operates from Hazeldean Office Park on Silverlakes Road, serving clients involved in land and property disputes across Pretoria.

Netcare Pretoria East Hospital is a private hospital on the corner of Garsfontein and Netcare Roads in Moreleta Park, with 358 beds, two dedicated intensive care units and 13 operating theatres. Its 24-hour accident and emergency unit includes a helipad, allowing critically injured or ill patients to be flown in directly for emergency treatment.

As one of the larger private hospitals in the Netcare group, the facility provides a full range of acute and specialist care under one roof rather than referring patients elsewhere for major procedures. Netcare Pretoria East Hospital serves patients from across Pretoria East and the surrounding suburbs.

New Perspective Design is a web design and development studio in Zwartkop, Centurion, with over 10 years in business, building mobile-responsive, SEO-structured WordPress websites intended to rank in search results and generate leads for clients. Pricing for a website typically runs from R1,990 to R18,000 depending on project scope, with basic builds taking 7 to 10 working days, basic e-commerce sites 7 to 14 days, and custom builds up to 35 days once content is supplied.

Beyond standard website design, the studio offers eCommerce, SEO and content marketing services, and builds custom WooCommerce plugins, headless WordPress sites and CRM integrations in-house rather than outsourcing development work. New Perspective Design has worked with businesses across South Africa, including in Cape Town, Durban and its home city of Pretoria.

Oi! Active Clothing has been setting trends in gym, dance and swim activewear since 2002, and is the official South African distributor of Bro Fitwear, a Brazilian activewear brand known for bold prints and premium fabrics. The brand markets itself around imported Brazilian style, offering activewear built to move with the wearer across gym training, dance classes and swimwear, rather than being limited to a single activity.

Customers can shop in person at Waterkloof Corner Shopping Centre or order online through the brand's own store, with free shipping offered on orders over R2,000 within Gauteng for those who prefer to shop from home. Oi! Active Clothing trades from Shop 11, Waterkloof Corner Shopping Centre, on Crown Street in Brooklyn, Pretoria, serving customers across the city looking for imported activewear.

Orange Line Engineering, founded in 2004, began by manufacturing washing lines and has since grown into a structural steel fabrication company in Hennopspark specialising in the design, detailing, manufacture and erection of steelwork such as carports, washing lines, hangers, stairs, balustrades, gates and fences. The company also offers powder coating, applying durable, high-quality finishes that extend the lifespan and appearance of metal products.

Its workshop includes fibre laser cutting capable of handling 1mm to 8mm mild steel and 1mm to 3mm stainless steel, alongside a Galantine machine for precision cutting of materials from 1mm to 6mm thick. Orange Line Engineering operates from Edison Crescent in Hennopspark, Centurion, serving clients who need custom steel fabrication work.

Padlangs Restaurant & Bar is a restaurant and bar in Derdepark Centre, Derdepoort, serving South African favourites such as skilpadjies and pap & kaiings alongside steaks, chicken strips and bacon. Reviewers describe the food as good value, the atmosphere as peaceful, and the service as friendly, with the venue rated 4.2 on Google from several hundred reviews.

The bar menu covers draft beer, wine and gin, along with coffee and milkshakes for those not drinking alcohol, making it a venue suited to both a casual meal and a longer evening out. Padlangs trades from Plot 190 Sefako Makgatho Drive, Derdepoort, Monday to Thursday from 07:00 to 21:00, Friday and Saturday until 23:00, and Sunday from 10:00 to 16:00.

Pentagon Projects has operated since 2000, specialising in office, industrial, luxury cluster and sectional title developments, with each project overseen by a dedicated partner and site foreman. Its portfolio includes the 60-room Mint Resort The Blyde hotel complex and the Crystal Lagoon addition to the existing lifestyle centre, along with fit-outs for the Maximo restaurant and The Villa at The Blyde.

The company has also delivered upmarket sectional title and cluster developments in Sandton and Hyde Park, including The Finn, Hyde Park House, Melrose 99 and 165 Dunkeld, reflecting a focus on higher-end residential and hospitality projects. Pentagon Projects operates from Monument Park, Pretoria, taking on developments across Gauteng.

PERI Formwork Scaffolding Engineering, in Louwlardia, is the South African arm of PERI Group, one of the world's largest manufacturers of formwork and scaffolding systems, founded in 1969 in Germany. The local operation supplies construction equipment for concrete formwork and scaffolding to building and civil engineering contractors across South Africa, drawing on a product range developed and refined over more than five decades internationally.

Beyond equipment supply, PERI provides engineering support throughout a project's lifecycle, helping contractors plan how formwork and scaffolding systems will be used on site, work out quantities and sequencing, and keep projects moving rather than simply delivering materials and leaving contractors to work out the detail themselves. PERI Formwork Scaffolding Engineering operates from PERI Boulevard in Louwlardia, Centurion, serving building and civil engineering contractors across the region.

Picardi Rebel in Eco Park Estate is part of a liquor retail franchise with over 35 years in the trade, stocking an extensive range of local and imported wines and spirits alongside beers, ciders and spirits for everyday drinking and special occasions alike. The Centurion branch is known for hosting in-store wine tasting tables over weekends, giving customers a chance to try bottles before buying rather than choosing from the shelf on label alone.

As part of a long-established national franchise, the store draws on decades of buying relationships to offer a wide selection that smaller independent bottle stores often cannot match, while still operating as a neighbourhood store rather than a large-format liquor warehouse. Picardi Rebel trades from Witch-Hazel Avenue in Eco Park Estate, Centurion, serving residents of the surrounding estate and nearby suburbs.

Plumblink Karenpark is a branch of Plumblink, a specialist plumbing, bathroom and kitchenware merchant trading from more than 100 branches across South Africa as part of the Bidvest group. The Karenpark branch stocks plumbing fittings and pipe systems, bathroom accessories and sanitaryware, taps, sinks and water-heating products, pumps and tanks, tools, drainage products and solar water-heating equipment, with its store open to both the trade and the general public.

The branch serves plumbers, builders, contractors and other tradespeople sourcing materials for local jobs, as well as property owners and members of the public shopping for plumbing, bathroom, kitchen and water-related products for their own homes. Operating from Shop 22, Karen Park Crossing, on the corner of Daffodil and Heinrich Avenue in Karenpark, Akasia, the store trades Monday to Thursday from 07:00 to 16:30, Fridays from 07:00 to 16:00, and Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00.

PPC Mooiplaas Aggregate Mine is a dolomite quarry in Erasmia and one of PPC's key aggregate operations in the Centurion area, extracting and processing dolomite rock for use well beyond standard building materials. The quarry supplies construction aggregates for civil construction projects such as roads and foundations, alongside materials used in the chemical, metallurgical and agricultural sectors.

As part of PPC, a long-established cement and materials group operating across Southern Africa, the Mooiplaas operation benefits from the group's wider logistics and processing infrastructure rather than running as a standalone quarry. PPC Mooiplaas is located off Skurweplaas Road in the Centurion area.

Ramulifho Inc Attorneys is a 100% black-owned law firm in Garsfontein practising employment law, litigation, arbitration and property advisory for individuals and businesses across Gauteng. The firm's work has included legal and compliance input behind the establishment of the South African Social Security Agency, giving it experience in large-scale public sector legal and institutional work alongside its day-to-day private client practice.

This mix of public institutional experience and private practice work means the firm can advise both individual and corporate clients on employment disputes, arbitration proceedings and property-related legal matters, drawing on a depth of experience that smaller general practices built purely on private client work may not have. Ramulifho Inc operates from Jacqueline Drive in Garsfontein, Pretoria, serving clients across the Pretoria area who need employment, litigation or property law advice.

Rasmatech designs and manufactures vandal-resistant infrastructure enclosures, including telemetry, substation, borehole and battery-bank enclosures, along with solar-powered systems, lattice masts, mobile solar trailers and mini-substations up to 33kV, for the industrial, mining, telecoms and civil sectors. The company carries out electro-mechanical design and manufacture, supply and installation in-house, using its own sheet-metal, laser, plasma and waterjet cutting along with CNC bending, punching and tube-laser bending and cutting.

A B-BBEE Level 1 company, Rasmatech also supplies proximity alert equipment, underground communication solutions and mobile mast and trailer systems, built to withstand theft and vandalism in remote or exposed locations. The company operates from Tek Base on Avro Road in Lyttelton, Centurion, serving clients across South Africa's mining and industrial sectors.

RE/MAX Jacaranda - New East was established in 2004 and its sales associates specialise in residential sales within the older and newer eastern areas of Pretoria. The office operates from the Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, next to the Virgin Active gym, and its proximity to several upmarket secure estates in the area keeps its agents active in marketing and selling properties within those estates.

Sales associates work as independent contractors who choose to associate with RE/MAX Jacaranda, and many belong to an internal network that shares property listings among up to 30 agents at a time, helping properties sell faster through wider internal exposure. The office's broker-owner has practised as an attorney, notary and conveyancer since 1987, giving agents direct access to legal advice during transfers, and the office carries a portfolio of well over 500 listings across Gauteng.

RNC Stainless By Design designs, manufactures and installs stainless steel, mild steel, glass and aluminium balustrades, handrails, windows, doors and gates for residential and commercial clients across Gauteng. The company also offers painting solutions alongside its metalwork, giving clients a single contractor for both structural fittings and the finishing work that follows installation.

Working across both new builds and renovations, RNC Stainless By Design handles projects from a single balustrade or handrail through to full sets of windows, doors and gates for a property, choosing materials to suit the setting, from stainless steel for a modern finish to aluminium for a lighter-weight option. The company operates from Blue Valley Golf Estate in Centurion, serving clients throughout Gauteng who need custom metal and glass work.

RQTech is a technology solutions company in Die Hoewes, Centurion, delivering enterprise content and process management software including Orbit Archive, an electronic document management system that removes the need for physical storage rooms and missing files, and Orbit Workflow, which automates business processes as documents and tasks move between participants. The company also offers CANEA ONE, a management system supporting daily work across documents, projects and goals, and QPR software for process mining, enterprise architecture and performance management.

Alongside these platforms, RQTech provides knowledge management solutions for contact centres, service desks and shared service environments, as well as bespoke software development, hosting and technical support for public and private sector clients.

RSW - Royce Steyl White Inc is a law firm in Muckleneuk established in 2024 by attorneys with decades of combined experience, aiming to provide high-quality, affordable legal services and practical solutions. The firm practises business rescue and turnaround, corporate and commercial law, criminal law, insolvency, dispute resolution and litigation, employment and labour law, family law, trusts and estates, and property law.

RSW works closely with each client to understand their particular needs rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach, and describes itself as committed to evolving its service offering as client needs change. The firm operates from Lange Street in Nieuw Muckleneuk, Pretoria, serving individual and business clients across a wide range of legal areas.

Safety Management Group - Pretoria is a health and safety consulting firm operating as an outsourced compliance partner for businesses that need fewer incidents and clearer safety systems. Its services include retainer packages, health and safety consulting, safety system implementation, compliance audits including ISO 45001, and industrial relations support, alongside accredited training.

The firm also offers specialist consulting in event safety planning, ergonomics, food safety and construction safety, as well as workers' compensation consulting, giving it reach across a wide range of industries beyond standard workplace safety. Safety Management Group operates from Olympus Drive in Olympus, Pretoria, serving businesses in and around the city.

Server Warehouse, supplying enterprise IT since 2007, is an online retailer in Midstream Estate stocking HPE ProLiant, Dell PowerEdge and Lenovo ThinkSystem servers alongside managed switches, routing, wireless and fibre networking equipment. Its range also covers NAS and SAN storage from brands such as Synology, UPS and backup power systems, and structured cabling including CAT5e, CAT6, CAT6A and fibre.

For businesses building their own server setups, Server Warehouse also sells empty rackmount server chassis from 1U to 4U along with rail kits and power supplies. Orders are delivered across South Africa or can be collected by appointment from the company's premises in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein.

SJ Dynamics is a Kilner Park business supplying, installing and maintaining power products including solar systems, UPS systems, batteries, generators and AVRs for clients across telecoms, mining, healthcare, education and retail sectors. Every project begins with a free on-site evaluation that includes technical reports and recommendations, and is then managed from order through to planning, installation and final commissioning.

A Level 2 B-BBEE company registered with the National Treasury's Central Supplier Database, SJ Dynamics has delivered power solutions for clients including DHL, Investec, SARS, Telkom, Transnet, hospitals and universities. The company operates from Isabel Street in Kilner Park, Pretoria, serving corporate, parastatal and government clients across South Africa.

Steel & Pipes for Africa is a steel, tubing and hardware merchant whose Pretoria West branch serves as head office among the company's 19 branches nationwide, trading for more than 32 years. The store stocks a wide variety of steel goods alongside paint, hardware, roofing and fencing products, serving everyone from DIY customers doing home projects to large contractors sourcing materials in bulk.

The Pretoria West Industrial branch has counter sales staff on hand to help with product and quote enquiries, and the company has also moved its price list online for customers planning ahead. Steel & Pipes for Africa trades from Industrial Road, Pretoria West, Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00, Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00, and is closed Sundays and public holidays.

Porsche Centre Pretoria is an authorised Porsche dealership in Die Wilgers selling new and pre-owned Porsche vehicles alongside Porsche Tequipment accessories and dealer merchandise. Its showroom and separate service, bodyshop and parts department operate on their own schedules, giving customers a place to browse new models as well as have an existing Porsche serviced or repaired.

Beyond the immediate Pretoria area, the dealership also serves customers as far afield as Mbombela, Middelburg, Witbank, Secunda, Polokwane and Rustenburg, reflecting Porsche's smaller dealer footprint in the region. Porsche Centre Pretoria trades from Botterklapper Street in Die Wilgers, open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 08:30 to 13:00, closed Sundays.

Pretoria Movers, previously trading as Olifants Rentals and with over 10 years of industry experience, is a furniture removal and logistics company handling home, office and corporate moves from its Clubview base. Customers can book packing services, with the option to pack their own boxes or have the Pretoria Movers team do it, before the company loads, delivers and offloads at the new location.

The company also handles national relocations and contract deliveries alongside local moves, using live truck tracking and WhatsApp updates to keep customers informed before and during a move. Pretoria Movers trades from Old Johannesburg Road in Clubview, Centurion, Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 08:00 to 14:00, closed Sundays.

Productive Systems, based in Rooihuiskraal with more than 37 years in business, designs and manufactures downstream automation systems for blow-moulding and injection-moulding production lines, serving over 350 customers across more than 30 countries. Its standard equipment range includes conveyor systems, bagging machines for empty plastic bottles, palletizers, leak testing machines, wadding machines for plastic caps, multi-part cap assembling machines and self-adhesive labelling machines.

The company serves industries including rigid plastic manufacturing, food and beverage, pharmaceutical and cosmetic, chemical and household, and automotive, and partners with Australia's Proile Solutions to supply leak testers for empty plastic bottles. Productive Systems also provides factory, logistics and process automation, including robotics installation and programming, from its base in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion.

Q&A ERP Solutions, based in Southdowns, Centurion, sells and implements Sage ERP software, with a particular focus on Sage Evolution and Sage 300, for a growing client base across Africa. Alongside selling and setting up the software, the company offers development, integration and custom reporting services for businesses that need their ERP system adapted to a specific workflow.

This combination of Sage reselling and custom development work lets Q&A ERP Solutions support clients through implementation and beyond, rather than handing over software with no further involvement. The company operates from Ngunis Street in the Southdowns Irene Country Farm estate, Centurion.

Radon Projects is a construction and civil engineering company founded in 1990, delivering commercial and industrial building projects, civil engineering works, and painting and renovations under one roof rather than through separate specialist contractors. The company was voted South Africa's Most Loved Construction Company in 2019, reflecting a focus on client relationships alongside the technical side of construction work.

Radon Projects is a member of BIFSA, SAFCEC and the Master Builders Association, industry bodies that set standards for construction firms operating in South Africa and give clients some assurance of accountability on a project. The company is based in Brummeria, Pretoria, taking on commercial and industrial building, civil engineering, and painting and renovation projects across the region for both public and private sector clients.

Railway Furnishers is a furniture and appliance retailer founded in 1961 near Pretoria's railway station, offering interest-free hire-purchase terms over 24 months on fridges, stoves, lounge and bedroom suites, televisions and more. Its range includes well-known brands such as Samsung, with options like smart televisions and wall-bed units sold alongside standard lounge and bedroom furniture.

Customers can also pay their account online through the EasyPay portal, using their EasyPay number and Railway Furnishers account number rather than visiting in person or calling. This branch of Railway Furnishers, on Paul Kruger Street, serves the Pretorius Park area of Pretoria with furniture and appliances on accessible payment terms.
